name: Doorman — Mindful Website Gatekeeper
description: A hotel doorman for your browser. Answer a password or a puzzle before entering time-sink sites. Friction, not a wall.

gecko._comment: AMO has required this since 2025-11-03. 'none' is the literal, truthful answer: Doorman has no server to send anything to (golden rule #1), and the statistics it keeps never leave the device.
